# KafkaFetchLatencyHigh

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| warning | kafka | [kafka-broker](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-broker/) | 10m / 1m |

**Summary:** <request> local time p99 on broker <kafka_broker> is above 1 s

Reading data for fetch requests takes the leader more than a second (local phase; long-poll waiting is excluded). Consumers or followers read from disk instead of the page cache, or the disk is saturated.

## Impact

Consumers or followers receive data late; lagging consumers fall further behind, followers may drop out of the ISR.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · Pods & Nodes → disk reads: reads > 0 under load mean data is no longer in the page cache (lagging consumers reading old data).
2. Kafka · Consumer Groups & Lag: which group reads far behind the log end?

## Mitigation

- Give the brokers more memory for page cache (container limit above heap), or let lagging consumers catch up off-peak.
- Spread hot partitions over more brokers.

## Expression

```promql
max by (kafka_cluster, kafka_broker, request) (kafka_network_requestmetrics_localtimems{request=~"FetchConsumer|FetchFollower",quantile="0.99"}) > 1000
```
